reasons: All mandatory evidence is fresh and valid for Egypt.

evidence_snapshot.timeframe: Past 12 months; Web Search; weekly series through 2026-08-09
evidence_snapshot.summary: Google Trends returned a query-specific Egypt series for Karseell over the past 12 months. Across 53 completed weekly observations, mean normalized interest was 40.85, median 45, and peak 100. The latest completed week was 53. Recent eight-week mean was 30.25 versus 66.75 in the prior eight weeks, but the last four completed weeks recovered to 50, 47, 52, and 53. Alexandria and Cairo were the top visible subregions, and 'karseell shampoo' was a rising related query at +200%.
limitations: Google Trends is a normalized index, not absolute search volume.
Zero-index weeks can mean insufficient sampled volume and are not interpreted as literal zero demand.
The current week beginning 2026-08-09 is incomplete and excluded from summary metrics.
Only the exact English brand query was used in this pass; Arabic and generic category terms remain a useful expansion test.
evidence_snapshot.collector: OpenAI browser-assisted research run for THINC v4.2

evidence_snapshot.summary: Meta Ad Library reported approximately 43 active keyword results in Egypt for Karseell. Twenty-one rendered cards were audited and 11 visibly mentioned Karseell in the advertiser, ad copy, or destination text, across eight distinct direct visible advertisers. Direct visible ads had start dates from 2026-02-16 through 2026-08-03. Recurring angles were authenticity, barcode inspection, hydration, frizz reduction, softness and shine, salon-like results at home, bundles, discounts, and free shipping.
limitations: The approximately 43 results are keyword matches, not 43 verified direct competitors.
Only 21 currently rendered cards were audited; 11 were visibly direct Karseell matches.
Meta Ad Library does not expose CTR, CPA, spend, sales, or profitability for ordinary commercial ads.
Competitor claims were recorded as creative messaging, not accepted as scientific or regulatory proof.

evidence_snapshot.query: Karseell Maca Power Collagen Hair Mask 500ml across Amazon Egypt, Noon Egypt, Jumia Egypt, and Faces Egypt
evidence_snapshot.summary: Thirty visible price points across major Egyptian marketplaces ranged from EGP 450 to EGP 1,499, with a median of EGP 719.73 and an interquartile range of EGP 606.48-950.50. Amazon Egypt showed examples with 4.3-4.4 star ratings, 450-650 ratings, and one listing marked 200+ bought in the past month. The wide dispersion and same-size duplication indicate established demand and intense seller competition, but also material authenticity and price-trust risk.
limitations: Marketplace ratings and purchase badges may be listing-specific, duplicated across variants, or inherited from catalog merges.
Price dispersion does not prove which listings are genuine, comparable, in stock, or delivered by authorized sellers.
Seller count and ratings do not reveal advertising profitability.

prerequisites: Meta Pixel is installed and firing correctly
Purchase event is configured and deduplicated
Conversions API is recommended for server-side resilience
Checkout and order confirmation flow have been tested
rationale: The business outcome is a purchase, so optimization must remain aligned with Purchase.
Traffic or video-view optimization can identify cheap visitors or viewers rather than buyers.

campaign_structure.ad_sets: One identical ad set per variant during controlled testing
campaign_structure.audience: Women 20-44 in Egypt with dry, frizzy, heat-damaged, dyed, or chemically treated hair; broad test with controlled creative variables
campaign_structure.placements: Advantage+ placements unless a placement-specific hypothesis is being tested
campaign_structure.exclusions: Exclude existing customers/purchasers for 180 days where data is available
campaign_structure.change_control: Change one variable only in each stage

graduation_gate: Hook and hold improve without damaging purchase quality
Choose format by delivered-order economics, not watch time alone

stages.variable_tested: Offer or CTA — one at a time

soft_stop_conditions: Spend reaches about 1× target Purchase CPA (32.40)
No Add to Cart / Checkout signal
Weak outbound CTR and weak early retention together
hard_stop_conditions: Spend reaches about 1.75× target Purchase CPA (56.70) with no purchase/order
Creative is weak at attention, intent, and conversion layers
No tracking or checkout defect explains the result
diagnostic_checks_before_kill: Verify website, checkout, form, or WhatsApp destination
Verify Pixel/CAPI and event firing when using a website
Verify price, stock, shipping, and offer clarity
Verify the call-center response time and qualification script

required_conditions: Delivered CPA is at or below the target
Delivery rate is at least 65% or the business-specific minimum
Results are stable for the minimum number of days
No operational bottleneck in stock, confirmation, or fulfillment
scaling_method: Increase budget in controlled steps rather than a single large jump
Keep the proven creative unchanged while validating the higher spend
Continue generating iterations from the winning angle to avoid fatigue
Recalculate CPA thresholds whenever price, cost, or delivery rates change
